ns2:course.label: Intro to General Eng Design
ns2:course.description: (G E 221) Fundamental concepts in the classical and computer-based analysis and design of structural and machine components and assemblies. External loads, internal forces and displacements in statically determinate and indeterminate configurations: kinematics of linkages, gears; and cams; static forces in machines Prerequisite: CS 101, MATH 225, TAM 212, and TAM 251.
